sources.fact: LBBD74/CF Castle Green is 67ha, mixed ownership, not-permissioned, with Brownfield capacity 0-7,000 net dwellings.
Brownfield notes state the site is currently SIL land; transformation assumptions do not erase current industrial-policy context.
CF supplies a point and blank geometry; the point is not the 67ha transformation boundary or any legal title polygon.

LBBD growth-hub page describes Castle Green as a future neighbourhood linked to a 1.3km A13 tunnel and states a plan for 5,000 homes plus parks/industrial/commercial uses and a new Overground station.

2023 Cabinet material describes Castle Green transformation potential up to 12,000 homes subject to A13 tunnelling and a new rail station; this is conditional strategic context, not consented capacity.
Cabinet committed to longer-term traveller-site provision within Castle Green strategic proposals; the decision is not a residential planning permission.
Regulation 19 decision materials list CF Castle Green allocation documentation separately from planning applications.
The adopted Local Plan provides strategic transformation policy but does not grant a whole-site Castle Green permission.
Development-plan status is policy evidence, not proof that tunnel/rail infrastructure or residential delivery is committed.
LBBD states Brownfield Register sites require planning permission.
No exact current whole-CF planning application was verified this wave; none is inferred from transformation strategy.
Planning Data coverage/geometry semantics do not allow blank transformation geometry to be replaced by buffers or neighbouring applications.

examples.result: CF remains not-permissioned despite strategic transformation ambition.
Brownfield 0-7,000 is retained as register capacity range, not consented units.
Growth-hub 5,000-home narrative is treated as a programme scenario, not a replacement for Brownfield capacity.
2023 Cabinet up-to-12,000 statement is conditional on major infrastructure and is not combined with 5,000 or 7,000.
Current SIL context is preserved until exact policy/application evidence changes it.
A13 tunnel/new station are conditions/dependencies, not assumed delivered infrastructure.
Blank CF geometry is not replaced by the park, tunnel corridor or nearest application red-line.
Promotion remains zero until exact current CF case/title relation and executed statutory overlays exist.
